sloka: सौमित्रे यो अभिषेक अर्थे मम सम्भार सम्भ्रमः ।अभिषेक निवृत्ति अर्थे सो अस्तु सम्भार सम्भ्रमः ॥२-२२-५॥
transliteration: saumitre yo abhiṣeka arthe mama sambhāra sambhramaḥ ।abhiṣeka nivṛtti arthe so astu sambhāra sambhramaḥ ॥2-22-5॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana the same enthusiasm with which preparations for my consecration were made be shown for the cessation of those arrangements.
